metrics.profile_summary: Digital Marketing Specialist with 5 years of experience in data-driven campaigns and social media management. Expert in Meta Ads, content strategy, and brand growth with proven leadership capabilities.

experience.description: Led a team of 10 executing social media ad campaigns, lead-generation strategies, and content creation across platforms.
Managed ambassador programs and author engagement networks via social media and digital ID systems.
Provided SEO-optimized content creation and managed social media portfolios and ad placements for clients.
Developed digital content to increase audience engagement and managed company social media accounts.
Implemented SMO initiatives and coordinated brand photoshoots to enhance visual narrative and visibility.

strengths: Extensive experience with Meta Ads and Social Media Management
Certified in Canva and Google Ads
Comprehensive technical toolkit including analytics and SEO
weaknesses: Primary degree is in IT rather than Marketing or Mass Communication
evaluation.summary: The candidate exceeds the minimum experience requirements and possesses all the requested technical skills, including the 'nice-to-have' tools. Their background in managing teams and diverse social platforms makes them an ideal fit for the Marketing Specialist role.
